raw_source_fragments: A good person left ... with memories of their beloved and responsibility keep them safe and alive
source.note: Ellipsis and grammar are preserved as supplied. This fixture tests semantic clarification, not source rewriting.

semantic_clarifications.user_authorized_contextual_sense: what ultimately remains with the person after their effort, care, time and responsibility; the residual outcome they retain
semantic_clarifications.applies_when: the phrase is used to ask or describe what remains/what the person retains after contribution
semantic_clarifications.does_not_apply_when: the context explicitly describes physical departure, death or spatial leaving

machine_sense_candidates: no return the speaker counts as materially comparable
semantic_clarifications.user_authorized_contextual_sense: zero or low tangible/material return while emotional, experiential and memory return may remain
semantic_clarifications.applies_when: nothing refers to lack of tangible/material personal return in this described pattern
semantic_clarifications.does_not_apply_when: the source explicitly states absence across all return dimensions

rejected_senses: a person who receives nothing is automatically good

user_authorized_contextual_sense.label: good
candidate_dimensions: low demand for equivalent personal return

semantic_clarifications.applies_when: interpreting the user's value label in this described relationship/care pattern
semantic_clarifications.does_not_apply_when: used as a universal moral definition without additional cases and counter-cases

human_rubric_change_candidate.statement: For Human memory analysis, emotional significance/value should be evaluated separately from positive/negative valence; negative or painful memory is not equivalent to insignificant or worthless memory.
human_rubric_change_candidate.applies_when: evaluating significance, retained value or behavioral influence of a Human memory
human_rubric_change_candidate.does_not_apply_when: a task is specifically measuring valence only rather than significance/value

pattern_candidates.name: NON_MATERIAL_RETURN
pattern_candidates.statement: Effort/care may produce little or no equivalent tangible personal return while memories, moments or other non-material returns remain.

pattern_candidates.name: EMOTIONAL_MEMORY_ACCUMULATION
pattern_candidates.statement: Shared experience may accumulate into emotionally significant memory whose importance is not reducible to positive/negative valence.

pattern_candidates.name: RESPONSIBILITY_PERSISTENCE
pattern_candidates.statement: Responsibility/care may persist beyond one completed action and seed later actions toward the same relationship objective.

combined_pattern_candidate.name: CARE_CONTRIBUTION_EMOTIONAL_RESIDUE_CONTINUING_DUTY
combined_pattern_candidate.statement: A caring actor may continuously invest effort and responsibility in loved ones without equivalent tangible return; emotionally significant memories and moments may remain while responsibility persists into later actions.

sequence_recurrence_model.invalid_model: one open in-place loop: care -> responsibility -> action -> memory -> renewed responsibility -> action

future trigger + threshold activates Sequence S_n+1
